guide: OrderReview(items, fees?, payment, title?, currency?) — a basket the user must approve before paying; items = [{name, qty, price}] (price is the LINE total), fees = [{label, amount}], payment = how it is charged ("UPI ending 4821"). Shows total and a hold-to-pay button (1.5 s hold, never a single tap). Use it before any purchase or payment. Events: place_order {items, fees, total, payment} (the user held to pay; only now place the order), edit_order {items}, cancel_order {}. Example: card = OrderReview([{name: "Amul Milk 500 ml", qty: 1, price: 59}], [{label: "Delivery + taxes", amount: 61}], "UPI ending 4821")

OrderReview.description: An order review with a hold-to-place-order button.

name.description: Item name with size, e.g. "Amul Milk 500 ml".

price.description: Line total for this item (not per unit).

fees.description: Extra charges shown muted under the items.

payment.description: How it is paid, e.g. "UPI ending 4821".

currency.description: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.
